assessment_summary.project_name: Battery pack front mount bracket FEA
assessment_summary.cou_name: Go/no-go for EVT bracket release and bolt class selection under 10 g longitudinal and service loads

evidence_keywords: Refinement study: Three meshes (M1/M2/M3)
Peak von Mises at the inner fillet: 257 MPa (M1, 2.0 mm), 246 MPa (M2, 1.5 mm), 242 MPa (M3, 1.0 mm)
Change M2→M3 = −1.6%
Displacement at the load reference: 0.66 mm, 0.63 mm, 0.62 mm
Solver controls: Geometric nonlinearity ON
Automatic time incrementation, initial 0.05, min 1e-6, max 0.2
Convergence tolerances default (residual 1e-3)
Contact chattering suppressed after switching to augmented Lagrange
Chassis interface plate modeled as rigid to isolate bracket behavior
compliance of the chassis rails is not included
Nonlinear contact and elastoplastic material enabled
Alternate constraint: Replaced rigid chassis plate with a 3 mm shell patch
true stress–strain from in-house tensile coupons (lot L3207)
fitted to a bilinear curve
Four M10 class 10.9 bolts represented with pretension sections (initial preload 18 kN each)
μ = 0.25 (phosphate/oil assumption)
Friction: μ varied 0.20–0.35
Hand estimate: Treat the inner lobe as a curved beam
aligns directionally with FEA

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: Decision tie-in: Go/no-go for EVT bracket release and bolt class selection
